desc:
🍕 Sell All the Pizza — Build the busiest pizzeria in town!

Bake delicious pizzas, carry huge stacks, and turn hungry customers into happy regulars! Start small, upgrade your ovens, and grow your pizza empire.

🔥 BAKE & MERGE — Buy ovens and merge three into one better oven to unlock rare pizzas!
🏃 STACK & SELL — Pile pizzas high in your arms, sell them at the counter, and serve hungry guests at your tables.
💰 COLLECT TIPS & CLEAN UP — Happy customers leave tips! Clear dirty plates to make room for your next guests.
👨‍🍳 HIRE HELPERS — Let chefs bake and serve while cleaners keep your pizzeria spotless.
🚚 LOAD & DELIVER — Fill your delivery truck with pizzas and send it off to bring back cash!
🔁 REBIRTH & EXPAND — Start fresh with permanent income boosts and unlock new areas.

Start with three ovens and three tables. Build a pizza empire.
